Exact-wheel import probe result (2026-09-03; exit 0)

Command prefix: `uv --no-config run --isolated --no-project --with python-hcl2==8.1.3 python -c <probe>`

Observed stdout:
```
8.1.3
(text: str) -> lark.tree.Tree
True
[('block', 1, 1, 3, 2), ('attribute', 2, 2, 2, 15)]
['__is_block__']
```

The lines are respectively distribution version; `inspect.signature(parses_to_tree)`; `parser().options.propagate_positions`; raw `Tree.meta` coordinates; and serialized metadata-like keys from `loads(..., SerializationOptions(with_meta=True))`.
